ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deep Dive into the $250 Million COVID-19 Relief Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future scandal, including the extradition of Abdullah Mahdi Hassan and the scope of the COVID-19 relief fraud scheme.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and explore the connections between entities and individuals involved in the scandal
questions: What were the methods used to carry out the fraud?
Who else was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future scandal highlights the need for increased oversight and regulation of COVID-19 relief programs to prevent similar fraud schemes.
